title: Meshy’s 3D Agent Remains in Beta and Reaches Free Users
summary: Meshy’s conversational 3D Agent remains in beta and is now available on the Free plan, combining concept generation, modeling and export in one workflow.
body:
## From prompt to production asset

Meshy’s 3D Agent remains in beta and is now available on the Free plan. Paid plans unlock higher limits and advanced tools, while users can chat with the Agent at no cost and spend credits on the actions they run. The product is aimed at a workflow that has traditionally required several separate tools: developing an idea, generating visual references, producing a 3D asset, refining it and exporting it for printing or game development.

The agent accepts natural-language instructions as well as photos and sketches. It can propose creative directions, generate batches of concepts, turn selected designs into models and continue refining them through conversation. Meshy says users can export results in formats including FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL, BLEND, 3MF and DXF, covering game engines, digital-content tools and 3D-printing workflows.

## Why this is more than another text-to-3D feature

The significant change is the product boundary. Earlier generative 3D tools typically stopped after producing a single asset. Meshy’s agent is designed to coordinate several steps and preserve context between them. That makes it closer to a specialized creative assistant than a prompt box attached to a model.

The company’s own product materials describe use cases ranging from indie games and product concepts to printable objects and batch asset creation. The same workflow can also isolate multiple objects from a reference image and prepare them as separate models, reducing some of the manual setup work that slows down small creative teams.

## The open question

Meshy’s current product page shows the Agent as a beta feature available on the Free plan, with paid plans offering higher limits and advanced tools. The beta will test whether conversational orchestration actually improves production speed rather than simply making demos easier. Quality consistency, topology, material accuracy and licensing remain important once assets enter commercial pipelines. Meshy’s strongest claim is therefore not that it can generate a model, but that it can connect ideation to a usable deliverable. The market will judge that claim in finished projects, not isolated previews.
title_zh: Meshy的3D智能体仍处于测试阶段，并已向免费用户开放
summary_zh: Meshy的对话式3D Agent目前仍处于测试阶段，现已面向免费计划开放，同时整合创意生成、建模与导出流程。
body_zh:
## 从一句话走到可用资产

Meshy的3D Agent目前仍处于测试阶段，并已面向Free计划开放。付费计划可解锁更高额度和高级工具；用户可以免费与智能体对话，但实际执行操作仍会消耗额度。该产品试图整合过去需要多个软件完成的流程：提出创意、生成视觉参考、制作三维模型、持续修改，最后导出到打印或游戏开发工具中。

用户可以用自然语言，也可以上传照片或草图。智能体能够先提出创作方向，再批量生成概念图，把选中的方案转成三维模型，并通过对话继续调整。Meshy称，生成结果支持FBX、OBJ、GLB、USDZ、STL、BLEND、3MF和DXF等格式，覆盖游戏引擎、数字内容工具和3D打印场景。

## 它与普通文生3D有什么区别

真正值得关注的是产品边界发生了变化。早期的生成式3D工具往往只负责一次性生成一个资产，而Meshy的智能体试图连续协调多个步骤，并在步骤之间保留上下文。这使它更接近面向创作者的专业助手，而不是挂在模型前面的提示词输入框。

官方展示的应用范围包括独立游戏、产品概念、可打印物体和批量资产制作。同一套流程还可以从参考图中识别多个对象，并将它们拆分成独立模型，减少小型创作团队在前期整理素材时的手工工作。

## 仍待验证的地方

Meshy当前产品页面显示，3D Agent仍处于测试阶段，并已纳入Free计划；付费计划提供更高额度和高级工具。测试阶段的真正考验，是对话式编排能否提升生产效率，而不只是让演示更顺滑。模型拓扑、材质准确度、结果稳定性和商业授权，都会影响它进入真实项目。Meshy最重要的主张并不是“能生成模型”，而是能把创意直接连接到可交付资产；这个主张最终要靠成品项目验证。

sources.title: Meshy AI announcement on 3D Agent availability

cat_take_zh: Meshy真正押注的是工作流整合；若导出资产仍需大量返工，智能体就只是更顺手的建模入口。
cat_take_en: Meshy’s bet is workflow compression; if exported assets still require heavy rework, the agent is only a smoother modeling front end.
